Elaine (CS): Heads-up: ACME goes live next Wed. Quick checklist for the handoff — low-latency demo users, renewal conversation in 30d, want SRE/SE/CS alignment on caching, batching, streaming guidance. Who can join a 15m sync?
Ben (SRE): I can. Need to know their typical request size and concurrency. Are they streaming responses or single-shot generation?
Elaine (CS): Mostly streaming chat for product demo (avg 120 tokens/user message), spikes up to ~60 concurrent during demos. They also plan bulk embedding jobs nightly.
Alice (PM): Renewal signal: customer indicated potential expansion but wants stable 99th %ile latency < 250ms for short chats. If we miss SLA, renewal risk rises.
Carlos (Solutions Eng): For streaming chat at that scale we should enable warmup + prefix caching and continuous small-batch mode. Recommend: 1) prefill common prompts during demo window, 2) enable streaming flush interval 50ms, 3) set batch target 8 tokens or 30ms — whichever hits first.
Ben (SRE): Agree. Also suggest a lightweight warm-start: curl to an endpoint that primes KV cache for their most common prefixes before demo start. Example: 
```
# prime common prompts
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prime \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large","prompts":["Hello","How do I reset my password?","Show me usage"]}'
```
This keeps the model's cache hot for short sessions.
Dana (CS): Nice. Can we add a checklist I can hand to their ops contact? Short, actionable items they can run.
Elaine (CS): Yes — I'll draft. Items: run prime script 10min before demo, toggle streaming flush to 50ms, set batching target to 8, monitor 99th %ile latency on Console route 'chat/demo', and toggle fallback to cpu-quantized model if GPU pool saturated.
Carlos (Solutions Eng): For embeddings: recommend nightly batch window at off-peak, and use chunked batching (500 embeddings per batch). Also enable retry/backoff: 429 -> exponential backoff starting 200ms.
Ben (SRE): Ops note: set autoscale burst to +20% for 30m surrounding scheduled demos. Also add a lightweight healthcheck that fails open (returns cached stub) to avoid demo downtime.
OnboardBot: Reminder set: "Prime cache" at 2026-04-01T09:50:00Z for ACME demo (owner: Elaine). :bell:
Dana (CS): I'll share this with ACME ops + CC their engineer. Also will collect post-demo feedback via short survey link — want to capture latency perception + any hallucinations.
Alice (PM): For renewal tracking: CS to update account health tile after first live demo (green if 99th %ile < 250ms for 3 demos). If not, trigger SDR outreach.
Elaine (CS): Action items assigned: Elaine -> draft shareable checklist + survey; Ben -> healthcheck + autoscale tweak; Carlos -> prime script + batching defaults; Dana -> customer comms + feedback capture. Can we confirm owners by EOD?
Ben (SRE): Confirmed. I'll open infra ticket and post link here.
Carlos (Solutions Eng): Confirmed. I'll also include a short runbook snippet for their ops.
Elaine (CS): Thanks team :heart: We'll regroup after first demo to capture lessons and update the runbook.
